title: Responsible tourism is more than eco-tourism
description: What does “responsible tourism” mean to you?  Admittedly, to most of us – especially in urban India – it means something about eco-friendly travel, right? Not littering, maybe choosing a homestay over a five-star, perhaps skipping the plastic straw.  But according to the man credited with bringing responsible tourism to Kerala and beyond, Rupesh Kumar […] The post Responsible tourism is more than eco-tourism appeared first on Village Square.
